item.itunes:title: 「邦尼評測」最超值！高階滾筒「洗地」機器人，今年大黑馬！選購建議！科沃斯 T80S PLUS 完整評測（40000Pa、增壓滾筒、100度熱水、優缺點、快充、防纏繞 2026掃地機器人推薦？
item.itunes:author: 邦尼幫你 3C 科技 - 開箱評測
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ

值得閱讀的理由

  • 高性價比入門選擇：科沃斯推出的全新入門滾筒洗地機器人 T80S Plus 將高階滾筒技術下放到 1 萬 5 預算以內，提供給預算有限但想體驗滾筒洗地效果的消費者一個高 CP 值的選項 [[01:34](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=94)]。
  • 旗艦同款核心規格：雖然定位為入門款，但搭載了旗艦同款的高階風機（40,000Pa 大吸力）、滾筒增壓技術、以及 100 度熱水洗滾筒與 45 度熱風烘乾功能 [[02:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=172), [03:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=226), [09:06](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=546)]。
  • 完整的實測表現與選購建議：影片透過多達 15 項的嚴格地獄測試（包含清潔力、毛髮纏繞、避障、滾筒自清潔等），客觀分析了該機型的優缺點，並提供清楚的選購對照指南 [[09:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=584),

    (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=7207)]。

摘要

這部影片由「邦尼幫你 3C 科技」帶來科沃斯（ECOVACS）全新入門級高階滾筒洗地機器人 T80S Plus 的完整評測。官方開價為新台幣 14,999 元，主打將主流品牌的滾筒機器人價格拉至 1 萬 5 以內 [[01:34](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=94)]。主講人指出，T80S Plus 的目標客群並非往上打高階市場（該定位交給 T90S Pro），而是「向下打」，讓原本只能買傳統盤式機器人的用戶，有機會首次入門滾筒洗地機器人 [[02:14](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=134)]。

主要看點與硬體配置

T80S Plus 雖然身為入門款，但在硬體上誠意十足：

  • 強悍風機與防繞系統：搭載新一代風機，具備 40,000Pa 超大吸力與每秒 16 升大風量；主刷標配新一代氣旋導防繞滾刷及經典風刀防繞邊刷，並具備側向導流設計以減少毛髮纏繞 [[02:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=172)]。
  • Osmoroller 增壓水泵與自清潔：採用滾筒增壓設計（具備 32 路增壓出水），解決長滾筒出水不均問題；車尾不需手動拆洗污水盒，機體內部配有自清潔螺旋槳，在回站時會自動刮洗污水盒並抽回污水箱 [[03:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=226), [04:42](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=282)]。
  • 拖地與維護設計：滾筒每分鐘 220 轉（約 3,800g 對地壓力），具備 15mm 滾筒抬升與伸縮貼邊設計（可多伸出 1.5 公分貼邊洗地）；採用超細纖維紋滾筒，烘乾後能保持蓬鬆。維護上支援快拆設計、可拆卸坡道與底盤 [[05:36](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=336), [06:12](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=372)]。
  • 基站功能：擁有自動集塵、自動補水、自動清洗污水盒、最高 100 度熱水洗滾筒以及 45 度熱風烘乾 [[08:58](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=538)]。

避障與硬體限制

在避障與定位方面，T80S Plus 採用 LDS 雷射導航（機身厚度 9.5 公分），但沒有搭載視覺辨識鏡頭，而是採用 3D 結構光搭配沿邊感應器 [[07:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=422)]。這意味著它無法做到如高階機種般精細的 AI 視覺避障（如辨識寵物糞便等極複雜狀況），但相對地，對於在意隱私的使用者來說，物理上完全沒有被偷拍的可能 [[08:28](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=508)]。續航方面則搭載 5200mAh 電池 [[08:43](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=523)]。

15 關實測結果

  • 清潔力測試（餅乾屑、瓜子殼、紅豆）：總計 30 克測試物，回收比例達 96.8%，達到入門主流水準 [[12:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=764)]。
  • 角落清潔：餅乾碎屑回收比例約 83%，風刀邊刷表現接近一般伸縮邊刷 [[12:56](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=776)]。
  • 毛髮纏繞測試：鋪滿長度 70 至 80 公分毛髮的空間測試，毛髮成功分離且邊刷未纏繞 [[13:47](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=827)]。
  • 避障測試：無論開燈或關燈環境下，透過 3D 結構光皆能順利偵測並避開充電線、延長線等風險物品，並會放慢邊刷轉速降低纏繞風險 [[14:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=860), [15:04](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=904)]。
  • 滾筒清潔與續航：經 100 度熱水洗後，沾滿醬油的滾筒能有效洗淨 [[17:57](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=1077)]；標準模式下續航表現優異，充電耗時約 3 小時 22 分 [[17:16](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=1036)]。

選購建議

T80S Plus 適合：想用最低成本體驗滾筒洗地機器人、追求拖地乾淨度、且平時打掃前習慣將地上雜物收好、不需要太多進階智慧功能的用戶 [[20:07](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=1207)]。
若預算允許，建議選擇 T90S Pro 的情況：家中有地毯需要地毯遮罩、空間大需要無限續航、地上常有小雜物需要更好壁障、或希望擁有自動底盤清潔、主刷/邊刷抬升及語音助理等進階功能 [[20:28](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=1228)]。

影片網址：[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ) [[00:00](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=0)]

=============

本集將透過全新「15項地獄測試」檢驗幾大核心重點：

1. 40000Pa 大吸力與防纏繞：搭載高階同款 40000Pa 風機（16L/s 大風量），配備新一代氣旋導流防纏繞滾刷、旗艦級側向強風導流設計與風刀防纏繞邊刷；實測 70-80cm 長髮零纏繞過關，顆粒物回收率。

2. OZMO ROLLER 增壓活水洗地：27cm 加長超細纖維滾筒（改版滾筒最大差異：烘乾後維持蓬鬆不塌陷），內建增壓水泵實現 16孔32路增壓均勻出水；具備每分鐘 220 轉、3800Pa 對地壓力、外擴 1.5cm 伸縮貼邊洗地與 15mm 地毯抬升，並採用滾筒快拆與可拆洗底盤設計。

3. 免手動洗車尾污水盒：下放旗艦同款「污水盒自清潔螺旋槳」，回洗時自動刮洗機身污水盒並將髒污抽回基站，告別傳統滾筒機型車尾污水盒發臭堵塞的痛點。

4. 9.5cm 薄型機身與無鏡頭物理級資安：採用嵌入式 mini dToF 雷達，機身厚度僅 9.5cm；車頭採無視訊鏡頭的 3D 結構光搭配沿邊感應器，從物理上杜絕偷拍資安疑慮（但也因此無 AI 視覺辨識抬升主邊刷等進階策略，打掃前記得收拾地面雜物）。

5. 100度熱水洗基站：粉白配色基站支援自動集塵、自動補水、最高 100 度熱水注入機身增壓分離洗滾筒，以及 45 度熱風烘乾；內建 5200mAh 軟包動力電池。

本次評測重點：

- 產品定位解析：14,999 元下打傳統雙圓盤機種，與 T90S PRO / X12S PRO 規格差異對比

- 吸塵與防纏繞實測：40000Pa 風機 + 側向導流氣旋主刷 + 風刀邊刷，長髮測試零纏繞

- 定位與避障取捨：9.5cm 薄型機身、3D 結構光開關燈避障實測，無鏡頭設計的高資安優勢與限制

  • 旗艦同款核心規格：雖然定位為入門款，但搭載了旗艦同款的高階風機（40,000Pa 大吸力）、滾筒增壓技術、以及 100 度熱水洗滾筒與 45 度熱風烘乾功能 [[02:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=172), [03:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=226), [09:06](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=546)]。
  • 完整的實測表現與選購建議：影片透過多達 15 項的嚴格地獄測試（包含清潔力、毛髮纏繞、避障、滾筒自清潔等），客觀分析了該機型的優缺點，並提供清楚的選購對照指南 [[09:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=584),

    (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=7207)]。

摘要

這部影片由「邦尼幫你 3C 科技」帶來科沃斯（ECOVACS）全新入門級高階滾筒洗地機器人 T80S Plus 的完整評測。官方開價為新台幣 14,999 元，主打將主流品牌的滾筒機器人價格拉至 1 萬 5 以內 [[01:34](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=94)]。主講人指出，T80S Plus 的目標客群並非往上打高階市場（該定位交給 T90S Pro），而是「向下打」，讓原本只能買傳統盤式機器人的用戶，有機會首次入門滾筒洗地機器人 [[02:14](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=134)]。

主要看點與硬體配置

T80S Plus 雖然身為入門款，但在硬體上誠意十足：

  • 強悍風機與防繞系統：搭載新一代風機，具備 40,000Pa 超大吸力與每秒 16 升大風量；主刷標配新一代氣旋導防繞滾刷及經典風刀防繞邊刷，並具備側向導流設計以減少毛髮纏繞 [[02:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=172)]。
  • Osmoroller 增壓水泵與自清潔：採用滾筒增壓設計（具備 32 路增壓出水），解決長滾筒出水不均問題；車尾不需手動拆洗污水盒，機體內部配有自清潔螺旋槳，在回站時會自動刮洗污水盒並抽回污水箱 [[03:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=226), [04:42](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=282)]。
  • 拖地與維護設計：滾筒每分鐘 220 轉（約 3,800g 對地壓力），具備 15mm 滾筒抬升與伸縮貼邊設計（可多伸出 1.5 公分貼邊洗地）；採用超細纖維紋滾筒，烘乾後能保持蓬鬆。維護上支援快拆設計、可拆卸坡道與底盤 [[05:36](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=336), [06:12](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=372)]。
  • 基站功能：擁有自動集塵、自動補水、自動清洗污水盒、最高 100 度熱水洗滾筒以及 45 度熱風烘乾 [[08:58](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=538)]。

避障與硬體限制

在避障與定位方面，T80S Plus 採用 LDS 雷射導航（機身厚度 9.5 公分），但沒有搭載視覺辨識鏡頭，而是採用 3D 結構光搭配沿邊感應器 [[07:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=422)]。這意味著它無法做到如高階機種般精細的 AI 視覺避障（如辨識寵物糞便等極複雜狀況），但相對地，對於在意隱私的使用者來說，物理上完全沒有被偷拍的可能 [[08:28](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=508)]。續航方面則搭載 5200mAh 電池 [[08:43](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=523)]。

15 關實測結果

  • 清潔力測試（餅乾屑、瓜子殼、紅豆）：總計 30 克測試物，回收比例達 96.8%，達到入門主流水準 [[12:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=764)]。
  • 角落清潔：餅乾碎屑回收比例約 83%，風刀邊刷表現接近一般伸縮邊刷 [[12:56](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=776)]。
  • 毛髮纏繞測試：鋪滿長度 70 至 80 公分毛髮的空間測試，毛髮成功分離且邊刷未纏繞 [[13:47](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=827)]。
  • 避障測試：無論開燈或關燈環境下，透過 3D 結構光皆能順利偵測並避開充電線、延長線等風險物品，並會放慢邊刷轉速降低纏繞風險 [[14:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=860), [15:04](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=904)]。
  • 滾筒清潔與續航：經 100 度熱水洗後，沾滿醬油的滾筒能有效洗淨 [[17:57](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=1077)]；標準模式下續航表現優異，充電耗時約 3 小時 22 分 [[17:16](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=1036)]。

選購建議

T80S Plus 適合：想用最低成本體驗滾筒洗地機器人、追求拖地乾淨度、且平時打掃前習慣將地上雜物收好、不需要太多進階智慧功能的用戶 [[20:07](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=1207)]。
若預算允許，建議選擇 T90S Pro 的情況：家中有地毯需要地毯遮罩、空間大需要無限續航、地上常有小雜物需要更好壁障、或希望擁有自動底盤清潔、主刷/邊刷抬升及語音助理等進階功能 [[20:28](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=1228)]。

在避障與定位方面，T80S Plus 採用 LDS 雷射導航（機身厚度 9.5 公分），但沒有搭載視覺辨識鏡頭，而是採用 3D 結構光搭配沿邊感應器 [[07:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=422)]。這意味著它無法做到如高階機種般精細的 AI 視覺避障（如辨識寵物糞便等極複雜狀況），但相對地，對於在意隱私的使用者來說，物理上完全沒有被偷拍的可能 [[08:28](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=508)]。續航方面則搭載 5200mAh 電池 [[08:43](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=523)]。

15 關實測結果

  • 清潔力測試（餅乾屑、瓜子殼、紅豆）：總計 30 克測試物，回收比例達 96.8%，達到入門主流水準 [[12:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=764)]。
  • 角落清潔：餅乾碎屑回收比例約 83%，風刀邊刷表現接近一般伸縮邊刷 [[12:56](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=776)]。
  • 毛髮纏繞測試：鋪滿長度 70 至 80 公分毛髮的空間測試，毛髮成功分離且邊刷未纏繞 [[13:47](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=827)]。
  • 避障測試：無論開燈或關燈環境下，透過 3D 結構光皆能順利偵測並避開充電線、延長線等風險物品，並會放慢邊刷轉速降低纏繞風險 [[14:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=860), [15:04](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=904)]。
  • 滾筒清潔與續航：經 100 度熱水洗後，沾滿醬油的滾筒能有效洗淨 [[17:57](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=1077)]；標準模式下續航表現優異，充電耗時約 3 小時 22 分 [[17:16](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=1036)]。

選購建議

T80S Plus 適合：想用最低成本體驗滾筒洗地機器人、追求拖地乾淨度、且平時打掃前習慣將地上雜物收好、不需要太多進階智慧功能的用戶 [[20:07](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=1207)]。
若預算允許，建議選擇 T90S Pro 的情況：家中有地毯需要地毯遮罩、空間大需要無限續航、地上常有小雜物需要更好壁障、或希望擁有自動底盤清潔、主刷/邊刷抬升及語音助理等進階功能 [[20:28](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UkG-ozhNfQ&t=1228)]。

item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o1tvIza-Sas

值得閱讀的理由

  • 搶先了解 Apple 首款摺疊手機 iPhone Duo 的機身材質、亮面鈦金屬邊框與抗指紋耐刮表現。
  • 透過專業燈條實測與特殊還原手法，客觀對比 iPhone Duo 與三星 Fold 6、OPPO Find N6 在摺痕深度與螢幕平整度的真實水準。
  • 深入剖析獨特霧面摺疊螢幕的致命缺點，揭露室內頂光與強光環境下畫面泛白、飽和度下降等潛在痛點。

摘要

外觀設計與頂級用料解析

作者針對 Apple 首款摺疊旗艦 iPhone Duo 進行實機上手實測。該機在材質上採用了頂規配備，正面搭載第二代超瓷晶盾，背面為第一代超瓷晶盾，並回歸使用亮面鈦金屬邊框以兼顧超薄結構與強度。然而，作者指出「午夜色」搭配亮面金屬極易成為指紋收集器且可能較易刮傷，使用者在日常維護上需特別小心。

摺痕真實深度與旗艦競品實測對比

針對大眾最關注的摺痕問題，作者將其與摺疊旗艦三星 Fold 6 及 OPPO Find N6 進行對比。由於 iPhone Duo 表面具備極為細緻的微米級霧面塗層，光線照射會產生漫反射，作者透過貼附超薄透光膜還原亮面，才得以測出真實凹陷。實測顯示其物理摺痕深淺與 Fold 6 相當，雖不及 Find N6 淺，但在原生霧面塗層覆蓋下，肉眼日常觀看幾乎能達到「幾近無摺痕」的視覺效果。

螢幕平整度與鉸鏈觸感體驗

在螢幕平整度指標上，三星憑藉專屬較厚 UTG 超薄玻璃 與鈦金屬支撐架構依然穩居冠軍。iPhone Duo 的平整度表現雖略優於 Find N6，但與 Fold 6 相比仍有差距，且用手指滑過鉸鏈處能摸到較明顯的起伏感。不過，這項平整度微瑕同樣因優異的霧面漫反射特性在點亮螢幕時被完美隱藏。

成也霧面、敗也霧面：頂光源下的視覺挑戰

作者將這塊螢幕總結為「成也霧面，敗也霧面」。霧面塗層雖徹底解決了摺痕與平整度的視覺問題，但在客廳、辦公室等頂部光源或戶外直射環境下，漫反射會造成嚴重的泛白干擾，導致畫面清晰度與色彩飽和度明顯下滑，在暗色介面下甚至需拉高亮度才能看清。作者認為手機常隨角度變換面對頂光，這項設計確實帶來眩光困擾，建議 Apple 未來應提供亮面選項，並提醒觀望消費者先至實體門市體驗。

================================================

Before you get an iPhone series, you should take a look at these eight key points first. Hi, welcome back, I’m Donkey. The hands-on review of the iPhone Duo is now live. Now, let’s take a look at how this version performs in real life. As usual, this episode is focused on key tests, but we’ll still measure as much data as possible and share it with you quickly. There’s still a ton of data, and you’ll definitely see some new insights. Don’t worry about the tests. that take longer to run; we’ll cover those in the next full review. Anyway, how does Apple’s first-ever foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, perform? Let’s take a look together. Right here on my desk is the iPhone Duo, which is worth over 300,000. Just kidding, I still think everyone should stay calm. Those who didn't snag the first batch can take this time to see what the real user feedback is like after the iPhone Duo launch. Also, don't forget that. Apple’s first foldable, the iPhone Duo, isn't just an iPhone with a bigger screen; it’s a brand-new interface overhauled from the system level. So the biggest problem right now is that a huge number of apps are still waiting for optimization. Plus, the supply for this first batch really isn't high, so many developers are likely still waiting to get their hands on a device. Let alone optimizing for it. Anyway, before we start, don’t forget to subscribe so you don't miss the full review when it goes live. Alright, let’s dive straight into the first. key point: design. First, regarding the body design, as Apple’s first flagship foldable, it definitely uses the best materials from their history, including the second-gen Ceramic Shield covering the front screen. The back cover uses the first-generation Ceramic Shield. It also features the titanium metal frame that has disappeared from the Pro series, ensuring the iPhone Duo maintains enough structural strength despite the ultra-thin design. We picked up the Midnight color, which I personally prefer. Paired with the matching MacBook Air, the whole set looks quite beautiful. However,. observant friends should have spotted the problem: yes, the Midnight color combined with the glossy titanium frame is an unavoidable, super-powered fingerprint magnet. Apple's dark color choices this year, including the Burgundy Red on the 18 Pro series and this Midnight Duo, are really prone to smudges; I feel they could adjust this for the next generation. Also, a quick warning: the Duo’s glossy metal frame will likely be quite prone to scratches . Take a look at this glossy titanium frame in my hand. Those who care about this should pay extra attention. However, I believe what everyone is most concerned about is how the iPhone's crease actually performs, right? First of all, since this is Apple's first foldable phone, let me provide some context. Currently, there are three main indicators for evaluating Apple's foldable screen craftsmanship. First, the depth of the crease itself. Second, the overall flatness of the screen. Third, the anti-wrinkle effect of the screen. As a tech channel that has thoroughly explored foldables, we’ve brought out the top foldable phones from all sides to give you a feel for the current.

market state. Starting with crease depth, we can verify this using our channel's signature light bar test. As you can see on screen, most current foldable phones have nowhere to hide under the light bar. When the light bar passes over the crease, it creates a visible shadow. But starting this year, more brands are specifically addressing the folding challenge. For example, this year's Samsung Fold6 series uses thicker UTG ultra-thin glass to make. the screen feel firmer and flatter. Samsung also added a brand-new titanium support structure under the foldable screen to prop up the flexible display. So you can see from the footage that the depression is clearly shallower than other flagships. But when it comes to this year's king of imperceptible creases, we absolutely have to mention OPPO's Find N6. You can see that under the light bar test, the Find N6 achieves a smaller crease depth thanks to its shallower multi-hinge design. The biggest contributor to its flatness is that OPPO performs targeted adjustments on the folding structure of every single Find N6. Although the process is significantly more complex, it truly achieves a relatively flatter effect; otherwise, everyone wouldn't be saying the N 6's crease is impressive. Plus, the N6 I've been using as my daily driver for several months is still holding up great. Alright, with that basic concept in mind, let's get back to the iPhone's crease—how deep is it exactly? As we all know, Apple has applied a very fine matte finish. directly onto the iPhone's surface. When we shine our light bar on it, the light just diffuses. But how could we just leave it at that? After all, when looking from the side or touching it, you can feel that this crease is actually not that shallow; there is a noticeable depression. So we have to bring out the crystallization of human wisdom to restore the glossy surface. We are using ultra-thin, flexible clear tape, adhering it as perfectly as possible to the matte screen to make the crease visible again. Now we can. finally see the true depression of the iPhone Duo. As you can see on the screen, even after removing the matte film that provides cover, the iPhone's actual crease remains very noticeable. Comparing it to conventional foldables, the light reflection test performs well , and it can be placed in the same tier as the Samsung Z Fold 6 in terms of comparison. It’s safe to say it’s a fold, but the crease isn't as shallow as the N6. The point is, don't forget, the iPhone Duo was originally a matte. screen. So, after peeling off the protector, the Duo is indeed one of the closest options to a "non-existent" crease to the naked eye. However, since it's still a new device, I'll share more updates with everyone after some time. In terms of the device itself, the actual depression is on par with the Fold 6, but with the matte screen, it truly has the potential to feel almost invisible. I must remind you that although we have applied the film as smoothly as possible, it should only be used as a reference for the level of depression. Moving on to the light bar test and the second metric, flatness,.

if we talk about the current king of flatness in the Android camp, the folding veteran Samsung Fold 6 surely holds the throne. As the largest supplier of foldable screens, Samsung exclusively crafted a thicker UTG ( Ultra Thin Glass) for itself, paired with a new generation of screens supported by ultra-thin titanium metal. Through the intensive light test, we can intuitively see that regular foldable screens are made of flexible materials, and the hardest parts to control are the four corners. Unevenness creates a ripple-like effect , and the light reflection becomes unusually chaotic. On the Fold 6, although there is still some deformation in the top right corner, most of the light reflection is significantly smoother. Even compared to the N6, the better UTG still shows that they kept the best materials for themselves. That covers the differences in screen flatness. However, this test really couldn't be done on the iPhone's matte screen. Based on my current testing, its flatness is slightly better than the N6, but there is still. a certain gap compared to the Fold 6. Furthermore, in terms of feel, there are more obvious bumps over the hinge support, but it's the same solution: this fine matte treatment completely solves the issue of flatness. But coming back, we’ve talked about many advantages of this matte screen; thanks to the matte finish, both the depression and flatness provide a very strong actual experience for me. So, what are the downsides? Honestly, from my experience so far, the iPhone's foldable screen can be described as " made by matte, ruined by matte." The. strong part is that as long as the screen is lit, you don't need to worry about creases or flatness issues at all ; everything can be hidden by the matte finish. But the problem with this matte finish is that under overhead lighting, such as a living room light, office ceiling lights, or outdoor use, it creates significant visual interference . Especially with dark-colored scenes, like the login screen of Honkai: Star Rail, even under normal studio lighting , it looks quite hazy, and I almost have to turn the brightness up to the. maximum to see it clearly. But look, when I lift it above my head and there's no reflection, the screen is still beautiful. Based on my testing so far, in any environment with lights on, even in mild cases, there is a drop in screen clarity and saturation. This is visible on camera, and even more obvious to the naked eye. The main issue is that for monitors or laptops —products not typically hit by direct overhead light—using this ultra-fine matte finish is like adding wings to a tiger. For example, I have a MacBook Pro here with an optional matte screen. On that device, the ultra-matte finish completely eliminates screen reflections. However, with a phone, the angle changes constantly, and the screen often faces overhead lights. The matte finish does indeed require constant angle adjustments due to glare . In short, the matte reflection issue that has been debated abroad is real; for those who are hesitant, I suggest trying it out in person before deciding . Alright, having covered the creases, I hope that satisfies your curiosity. So, what are your thoughts on this.

iPhone Duo screen? Personally, I would hope Apple follows their iPad and MacBook product lines in the future by offering both anti-reflective glossy and matte options on the Duo, or making the matte layer a removable screen protector. That way, users could still choose between maintaining a crystal-clear glossy look or a super-matte finish for ultimate anti-reflection via a screen protector. Plus, if the screen gets scratched, a screen protector could be replaced, whereas now, a scratch is just a scratch. Alright, that wraps up the key. points on the display. As for the exterior, there are three more key points about the iPhone Duo. First, the iPhone Duo features an IP68 water resistance rating, which is relatively rare for foldables, so you don't have to worry about using it outdoors. Second, in terms of hand-feel, the presence of the iPhone is certainly quite significant. While the similarly positioned Samsung Fold4 is only 201 grams, and the larger Fold4 Ultra is 215 grams, at 225 grams, Apple’s iPhone Duo reaches a staggering 254 grams. It’s even heavier than the very heavy iPhone 16 Pro Max, which is. quite surprising, especially combined with the 8.4 cm body width. One-handed grip will be a major test, so I suggest checking in-store if your hand can manage it. Finally, the iPhone Duo only supports eSIM, so you cannot insert a physical SIM card. After purchasing, it is recommended to ensure the phone has no issues before going to the carrier store to transfer your number. Additionally, the iPhone Duo uses a long-lost Touch ID, but its speed is relatively average by 2026 standards. Interestingly, the volume buttons have been moved to the top of the body; while logically clever to suit an intuitive portrait experience, my experience so far is that there is still a learning curve to having them on top. Regarding this first foldable iPhone, let me quickly share some accessory options for the foldable. First, you can apply a glass screen protector to the outer screen. The official store sells two types of cases : one is this magnetic version. The other is a foldable-style case, which relies on adhesive strips to attach to the device body. One reminder: it is recommended not to wrap the hinge, to avoid affecting the internal structure. If you are concerned, please choose a product that offers hinge protection. Also, if your case blocks the screen, you can enable the "Adjust to Left Edge " option in settings, and the system will reformat the interface to accommodate the case. Next, the third major highlight: it’s time for our channel’s tradition of testing the display performance using equipment we’ve invested over $ 10,000 in. First, let's test brightness. Both screens on the iPhone Duo share the same brightness specs, featuring a Super Retina XDR 2 display with a rated. 1000 nits maximum brightness and 3000 nits peak outdoor brightness. After our hands-on testing, the full-screen maximum brightness for both the inner and outer displays on the iPhone Duo does indeed reach the rated 1000 nits. Furthermore, regarding peak brightness, our tests show that the iPhone Duo can reach the officially claimed 3000 nits peak brightness on 25%of the display area. Overall, Apple has maintained 1000 nits for full-screen brightness this generation, which is a bit struggling by 2026 standards. As other brands are moving toward 1500 or even 2000 nits, this is definitely a.

hardware upgrade Apple must keep up with in the next generation. It will still be a bit difficult to see under the sun, but the 3000 nits peak brightness hits flagship levels, which can effectively unlock HDR video content. In terms of color, our testing shows that this year's iPhone CCT has also followed the 16 Pro series, moving away from the traditional sRGB standard . I have provided the white point coordinates for both the inner and outer screens for your reference. Finally, we want to test the PWM for those with sensitive eyes. Apple also. provides a "Smooth PWM" option in the iPhone Duo settings. As you can see on the screen, once it's turned on, the PWM does become smoother. We are bringing out our expensive equipment to test the iPhone Duo's true PWM. But before that, since this show is always objective and thorough, please subscribe and support us. For you, subscribing is completely free, but for us, it is truly important. The results show that regardless of whether the smooth PWM is on, the actual PWM for. both screens remains 480Hz. Moving on to the experience segment, I originally intended to share the charm of foldables and how much of a gap it creates compared to traditional smartphones, as the goodness on Android is coming to iOS. However, after playing with it, the situation I was most worried about has actually happened. Most of the apps have not been optimized yet. For instance, LINE has absolutely no interface adjustments . Facebook has, but games like Genshin. Impact and Honkai: Star Rail have not been updated. Even Apple's own Apple Store hasn't been fully adapted. Come on, Apple. So I must say, evaluating this system at this point is a pity; there are too many imperfections, and it's not even ready to compete with Android. Otherwise, the opening animations and the side control interface are fresh ideas that Apple. executed well, but I think we should give it more time before a full review, or this screen is wasted. Speaking of screens, yes, this foldable screen is still very suitable. For DeskKing, the remote software I use daily, it has three key features: First, it's intuitive; you can connect to your home PC via phone or use your iPad as a secondary monitor. Second, it offers low latency, allowing me to edit videos. remotely; even complex projects work fine, and file transfer speeds are great. DeskKing also focuses on remote gaming; look at me playing games remotely on my 5090 PC with a regular laptop—the latency is quite good, with up to 4K60FPS or 2K240FPS, and it supports controllers too. Most importantly, Deskasking is a truly reliable remote software, whether you're working remotely from home or helping seniors solve phone issues. You can even use DKing for remote startup;

I'm out right now, but I just tap the remote power button in the app, and look, my home computer turns on instantly. Check out this video for the tutorial. For those interested, most features are available in the free version of DKing. For advanced needs, I recommend the Asking Gaming version as it's the most versatile. The link is in the pinned comment. Thanks again to DKing for making our production process worry-free. By the way, I look forward to the official team releasing an optimized version soon. Back to the show, next is the fifth key highlight:. charging. iPhone Du also hides a USB-C port and supports the USB 3 transfer protocol, reaching speeds of up to 10GB /second. It’s still much more convenient for transferring files. The good news is that iPhone Du also supports Apple’s latest generation fast-charging protocol. Our tests show that at low battery levels, peak wattage can reach about 36 watts. As for overall charging speed, using Apple’s original 60W dynamic charger, it takes about 30 minutes. It can charge up to 50%, and fully charge in about an hour. The total time to reach a full charge is about one hour and 17. minutes, which is slightly slower than this year's 18 Pro series. However, it is still faster in charging speed than any model prior to the 17 Pro series. Alright, let's move on to the sixth highlight: performance. As Apple’s first foldable flagship, iPhone Duo definitely uses the exceptionally powerful Apple A20 Pro chip, paired with generous memory. If you want a deeper understanding of this great piece of tech, feel free to check out our final iPhone 18 Pro series review, where there is a more detailed analysis. . In this episode, we will only verify one question. Is there any gap in peak performance compared to the iPhone 18 Pro series? First, our tests show that the iPhone's single-core and multi-core performance, while slightly lower in comparison, basically reaches the same top-tier level as the thermally improved iPhone 18 Pro series in GB7 peak benchmarks. However, looking at the more GPU-intensive 3DMark Solar Bay test, the iPhone Duo shows about a 3.5% difference in peak performance. As for. connectivity, the iPhone Duo is fully equipped with the self-developed C2 + N1 chip, supporting advanced specifications like 5G, Wi-Fi 7, and BLE 6.0. Without further ado, let’s jump into the gaming and stress test segment. That’s right, even though time is tight, we still ran a full session of Honkai: Star Rail. We also ran Honkai: Star Rail at max settings for 30 minutes. Our tests show that due to the folding mechanism's limited heat dissipation, the iPhone Duo struggles more than the 18 Pro. On the outer. screen, it averaged 58.83 FPS throughout, with 1%lows dropping to 29.3 FPS. The key point is that while the front stayed at a manageable 40 ° C, the back couldn't handle it, reaching a high of 46 ° C. We ran the same test on the inner screen, where the iPhone Duo averaged 58.85 FPS with 1%lows of 29.5 FPS. The real highlight is that when unfolded, both front and back temperatures hit 43 ° C, which is.

still slightly on the high side. In any case, we are currently deep into comprehensive testing for the iPhone, and I will provide full updates in the complete review. Let's move to our final focus: the camera. This year's iPhone Duo packs a 48MP main lens and a 48MP ultra-wide lens that doubles as a macro lens. It has a 12MP Stage selfie lens. Paired with an under-display lens . Honestly, the image quality of that. internal lens is basically webcam-level , and you can see the pixels in the under-display area with the naked eye. For selfies, I recommend using the outer screen or the main rear lens. It basically lacks a telephoto lens, and the main and selfie lenses differ slightly from the Pro series. But you should have known that when you chose the iPhone Duo. It was never meant to be a device that prioritizes a flagship camera system. The interesting part of the iPhone Duo lies in the various unique features exclusive to foldable devices. For example, simultaneous previews on the inner and outer screens. allow the person being photographed to see themselves and adjust their pose. Or, you can use the "Look Here" feature to grab a child's attention, or open the camera on the outer screen, unfold the device, and slide the camera view across the screen. See? Now we can use the rear main lens and ultra-wide lens to take selfies. As Apple's first foldable phone, they opted for a free-stop hinge, so you can set it on a table for hands-free selfies. Apple even provides features like Center. Stage and Smart Framing, where the system automatically frames shots based on your movements, making it quite fun. One thing to note is the orientation of the sensors. In fact, when you hold the iPhone Duo vertically, you are actually taking landscape photos. When you hold it horizontally, you are taking portrait photos, so you'll need to get used to it. Furthermore, in terms of functionality, although it lacks the shutter speed and aperture adjustments of the Pro series, the camera interface still allows for basic functions like. manual focus and white balance adjustment. Besides that, this iPhone also supports the Pro series 'Cinematic mode and 4K 120fps recording on the main lens, though the ultra-wide lens is limited to 4K 60fps. Alright, coming to the final conclusion, after getting my hands on this year's iPhone, I feel the current situation is quite clear. You can always trust Apple's craftsmanship and their design in areas they have full control over. In terms of the system, the iPhone perfectly reflects the quality expected from. Apple. At the same time, we’ve been testing foldable phones for years; starting from the first Samsung foldable, we’ve tried our best to test all the major ones that have come out. Long-time viewers know that we often share time and time again that a foldable is a product that cannot be built solely by stacking hardware specs . Software optimization is the core of foldable phones and it requires time to polish. For example, multi-window multitasking and the foldable keyboard. These are still in the exploration stage, which is the current state of this iPhone. Since Apple has completely overhauled the operating logic, we have.

to give it a little more time. I also want to experience it for a while longer, so be sure to come back for the full review. For those interested but who didn't manage to grab one at launch , there are three things you should check: first, can you truly accept the weight and the in-hand feel? Second, does the matte reflection issue on the screen interfere with your experience? If you are sensitive to display quality , you will indeed need to keep adjusting the viewing angle. Finally, take some time to confirm whether the software has been properly optimized. for this iPhone. For those who did manage to grab one, a quick heads-up: heat dissipation is indeed relatively limited. You will feel significant warmth during initial setup, but it’s within expectations, so no need to worry too much. Furthermore, the current system doesn't feel stable enough yet. For instance, we've encountered screen flickering when opening the camera, and the camera view freezing completely. It even showed a " non-genuine lens" warning, requiring a restart to return to normal. It might need an update, so let us take our time. and share the full test results with you later. Alright, that's it for the show, thanks to everyone for watching this far. Producing this content isn't easy, so your support is appreciated. You’re also welcome to join as a channel member or use the YouTube Super Thanks button to sponsor us in creating more valuable hands-on shows. If you have any questions, feel free to leave them in the comments below. I’m LuZi. See you next time. If you enjoyed this episode, don't forget to subscribe to Bunny, and turn on the notification bell to receive updates on our latest reviews. Of course, you can also find. us on Facebook at Bunny Assistant, Instagram, and Line.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o1tvIza-Sas

值得閱讀的理由

  • 搶先了解 Apple 首款摺疊手機 iPhone Duo 的機身材質、亮面鈦金屬邊框與抗指紋耐刮表現。
  • 透過專業燈條實測與特殊還原手法，客觀對比 iPhone Duo 與三星 Fold 6、OPPO Find N6 在摺痕深度與螢幕平整度的真實水準。
  • 深入剖析獨特霧面摺疊螢幕的致命缺點，揭露室內頂光與強光環境下畫面泛白、飽和度下降等潛在痛點。

摘要

外觀設計與頂級用料解析

作者針對 Apple 首款摺疊旗艦 iPhone Duo 進行實機上手實測。該機在材質上採用了頂規配備，正面搭載第二代超瓷晶盾，背面為第一代超瓷晶盾，並回歸使用亮面鈦金屬邊框以兼顧超薄結構與強度。然而，作者指出「午夜色」搭配亮面金屬極易成為指紋收集器且可能較易刮傷，使用者在日常維護上需特別小心。

摺痕真實深度與旗艦競品實測對比

針對大眾最關注的摺痕問題，作者將其與摺疊旗艦三星 Fold 6 及 OPPO Find N6 進行對比。由於 iPhone Duo 表面具備極為細緻的微米級霧面塗層，光線照射會產生漫反射，作者透過貼附超薄透光膜還原亮面，才得以測出真實凹陷。實測顯示其物理摺痕深淺與 Fold 6 相當，雖不及 Find N6 淺，但在原生霧面塗層覆蓋下，肉眼日常觀看幾乎能達到「幾近無摺痕」的視覺效果。

螢幕平整度與鉸鏈觸感體驗

在螢幕平整度指標上，三星憑藉專屬較厚 UTG 超薄玻璃 與鈦金屬支撐架構依然穩居冠軍。iPhone Duo 的平整度表現雖略優於 Find N6，但與 Fold 6 相比仍有差距，且用手指滑過鉸鏈處能摸到較明顯的起伏感。不過，這項平整度微瑕同樣因優異的霧面漫反射特性在點亮螢幕時被完美隱藏。

成也霧面、敗也霧面：頂光源下的視覺挑戰

作者將這塊螢幕總結為「成也霧面，敗也霧面」。霧面塗層雖徹底解決了摺痕與平整度的視覺問題，但在客廳、辦公室等頂部光源或戶外直射環境下，漫反射會造成嚴重的泛白干擾，導致畫面清晰度與色彩飽和度明顯下滑，在暗色介面下甚至需拉高亮度才能看清。作者認為手機常隨角度變換面對頂光，這項設計確實帶來眩光困擾，建議 Apple 未來應提供亮面選項，並提醒觀望消費者先至實體門市體驗。

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o1tvIza-Sas

值得閱讀的理由

  • 搶先了解 Apple 首款摺疊手機 iPhone Duo 的機身材質、亮面鈦金屬邊框與抗指紋耐刮表現。
  • 透過專業燈條實測與特殊還原手法，客觀對比 iPhone Duo 與三星 Fold 6、OPPO Find N6 在摺痕深度與螢幕平整度的真實水準。
  • 深入剖析獨特霧面摺疊螢幕的致命缺點，揭露室內頂光與強光環境下畫面泛白、飽和度下降等潛在痛點。

摘要

外觀設計與頂級用料解析

作者針對 Apple 首款摺疊旗艦 iPhone Duo 進行實機上手實測。該機在材質上採用了頂規配備，正面搭載第二代超瓷晶盾，背面為第一代超瓷晶盾，並回歸使用亮面鈦金屬邊框以兼顧超薄結構與強度。然而，作者指出「午夜色」搭配亮面金屬極易成為指紋收集器且可能較易刮傷，使用者在日常維護上需特別小心。

摺痕真實深度與旗艦競品實測對比

針對大眾最關注的摺痕問題，作者將其與摺疊旗艦三星 Fold 6 及 OPPO Find N6 進行對比。由於 iPhone Duo 表面具備極為細緻的微米級霧面塗層，光線照射會產生漫反射，作者透過貼附超薄透光膜還原亮面，才得以測出真實凹陷。實測顯示其物理摺痕深淺與 Fold 6 相當，雖不及 Find N6 淺，但在原生霧面塗層覆蓋下，肉眼日常觀看幾乎能達到「幾近無摺痕」的視覺效果。

螢幕平整度與鉸鏈觸感體驗

在螢幕平整度指標上，三星憑藉專屬較厚 UTG 超薄玻璃 與鈦金屬支撐架構依然穩居冠軍。iPhone Duo 的平整度表現雖略優於 Find N6，但與 Fold 6 相比仍有差距，且用手指滑過鉸鏈處能摸到較明顯的起伏感。不過，這項平整度微瑕同樣因優異的霧面漫反射特性在點亮螢幕時被完美隱藏。

成也霧面、敗也霧面：頂光源下的視覺挑戰

作者將這塊螢幕總結為「成也霧面，敗也霧面」。霧面塗層雖徹底解決了摺痕與平整度的視覺問題，但在客廳、辦公室等頂部光源或戶外直射環境下，漫反射會造成嚴重的泛白干擾，導致畫面清晰度與色彩飽和度明顯下滑，在暗色介面下甚至需拉高亮度才能看清。作者認為手機常隨角度變換面對頂光，這項設計確實帶來眩光困擾，建議 Apple 未來應提供亮面選項，並提醒觀望消費者先至實體門市體驗。

================================================

Before you get an iPhone series, you should take a look at these eight key points first. Hi, welcome back, I’m Donkey. The hands-on review of the iPhone Duo is now live. Now, let’s take a look at how this version performs in real life. As usual, this episode is focused on key tests, but we’ll still measure as much data as possible and share it with you quickly. There’s still a ton of data, and you’ll definitely see some new insights. Don’t worry about the tests. that take longer to run; we’ll cover those in the next full review. Anyway, how does Apple’s first-ever foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, perform? Let’s take a look together. Right here on my desk is the iPhone Duo, which is worth over 300,000. Just kidding, I still think everyone should stay calm. Those who didn't snag the first batch can take this time to see what the real user feedback is like after the iPhone Duo launch. Also, don't forget that. Apple’s first foldable, the iPhone Duo, isn't just an iPhone with a bigger screen; it’s a brand-new interface overhauled from the system level. So the biggest problem right now is that a huge number of apps are still waiting for optimization. Plus, the supply for this first batch really isn't high, so many developers are likely still waiting to get their hands on a device. Let alone optimizing for it. Anyway, before we start, don’t forget to subscribe so you don't miss the full review when it goes live. Alright, let’s dive straight into the first. key point: design. First, regarding the body design, as Apple’s first flagship foldable, it definitely uses the best materials from their history, including the second-gen Ceramic Shield covering the front screen. The back cover uses the first-generation Ceramic Shield. It also features the titanium metal frame that has disappeared from the Pro series, ensuring the iPhone Duo maintains enough structural strength despite the ultra-thin design. We picked up the Midnight color, which I personally prefer. Paired with the matching MacBook Air, the whole set looks quite beautiful. However,. observant friends should have spotted the problem: yes, the Midnight color combined with the glossy titanium frame is an unavoidable, super-powered fingerprint magnet. Apple's dark color choices this year, including the Burgundy Red on the 18 Pro series and this Midnight Duo, are really prone to smudges; I feel they could adjust this for the next generation. Also, a quick warning: the Duo’s glossy metal frame will likely be quite prone to scratches . Take a look at this glossy titanium frame in my hand. Those who care about this should pay extra attention. However, I believe what everyone is most concerned about is how the iPhone's crease actually performs, right? First of all, since this is Apple's first foldable phone, let me provide some context. Currently, there are three main indicators for evaluating Apple's foldable screen craftsmanship. First, the depth of the crease itself. Second, the overall flatness of the screen. Third, the anti-wrinkle effect of the screen. As a tech channel that has thoroughly explored foldables, we’ve brought out the top foldable phones from all sides to give you a feel for the current.

market state. Starting with crease depth, we can verify this using our channel's signature light bar test. As you can see on screen, most current foldable phones have nowhere to hide under the light bar. When the light bar passes over the crease, it creates a visible shadow. But starting this year, more brands are specifically addressing the folding challenge. For example, this year's Samsung Fold6 series uses thicker UTG ultra-thin glass to make. the screen feel firmer and flatter. Samsung also added a brand-new titanium support structure under the foldable screen to prop up the flexible display. So you can see from the footage that the depression is clearly shallower than other flagships. But when it comes to this year's king of imperceptible creases, we absolutely have to mention OPPO's Find N6. You can see that under the light bar test, the Find N6 achieves a smaller crease depth thanks to its shallower multi-hinge design. The biggest contributor to its flatness is that OPPO performs targeted adjustments on the folding structure of every single Find N6. Although the process is significantly more complex, it truly achieves a relatively flatter effect; otherwise, everyone wouldn't be saying the N 6's crease is impressive. Plus, the N6 I've been using as my daily driver for several months is still holding up great. Alright, with that basic concept in mind, let's get back to the iPhone's crease—how deep is it exactly? As we all know, Apple has applied a very fine matte finish. directly onto the iPhone's surface. When we shine our light bar on it, the light just diffuses. But how could we just leave it at that? After all, when looking from the side or touching it, you can feel that this crease is actually not that shallow; there is a noticeable depression. So we have to bring out the crystallization of human wisdom to restore the glossy surface. We are using ultra-thin, flexible clear tape, adhering it as perfectly as possible to the matte screen to make the crease visible again. Now we can. finally see the true depression of the iPhone Duo. As you can see on the screen, even after removing the matte film that provides cover, the iPhone's actual crease remains very noticeable. Comparing it to conventional foldables, the light reflection test performs well , and it can be placed in the same tier as the Samsung Z Fold 6 in terms of comparison. It’s safe to say it’s a fold, but the crease isn't as shallow as the N6. The point is, don't forget, the iPhone Duo was originally a matte. screen. So, after peeling off the protector, the Duo is indeed one of the closest options to a "non-existent" crease to the naked eye. However, since it's still a new device, I'll share more updates with everyone after some time. In terms of the device itself, the actual depression is on par with the Fold 6, but with the matte screen, it truly has the potential to feel almost invisible. I must remind you that although we have applied the film as smoothly as possible, it should only be used as a reference for the level of depression. Moving on to the light bar test and the second metric, flatness,.

if we talk about the current king of flatness in the Android camp, the folding veteran Samsung Fold 6 surely holds the throne. As the largest supplier of foldable screens, Samsung exclusively crafted a thicker UTG ( Ultra Thin Glass) for itself, paired with a new generation of screens supported by ultra-thin titanium metal. Through the intensive light test, we can intuitively see that regular foldable screens are made of flexible materials, and the hardest parts to control are the four corners. Unevenness creates a ripple-like effect , and the light reflection becomes unusually chaotic. On the Fold 6, although there is still some deformation in the top right corner, most of the light reflection is significantly smoother. Even compared to the N6, the better UTG still shows that they kept the best materials for themselves. That covers the differences in screen flatness. However, this test really couldn't be done on the iPhone's matte screen. Based on my current testing, its flatness is slightly better than the N6, but there is still. a certain gap compared to the Fold 6. Furthermore, in terms of feel, there are more obvious bumps over the hinge support, but it's the same solution: this fine matte treatment completely solves the issue of flatness. But coming back, we’ve talked about many advantages of this matte screen; thanks to the matte finish, both the depression and flatness provide a very strong actual experience for me. So, what are the downsides? Honestly, from my experience so far, the iPhone's foldable screen can be described as " made by matte, ruined by matte." The. strong part is that as long as the screen is lit, you don't need to worry about creases or flatness issues at all ; everything can be hidden by the matte finish. But the problem with this matte finish is that under overhead lighting, such as a living room light, office ceiling lights, or outdoor use, it creates significant visual interference . Especially with dark-colored scenes, like the login screen of Honkai: Star Rail, even under normal studio lighting , it looks quite hazy, and I almost have to turn the brightness up to the. maximum to see it clearly. But look, when I lift it above my head and there's no reflection, the screen is still beautiful. Based on my testing so far, in any environment with lights on, even in mild cases, there is a drop in screen clarity and saturation. This is visible on camera, and even more obvious to the naked eye. The main issue is that for monitors or laptops —products not typically hit by direct overhead light—using this ultra-fine matte finish is like adding wings to a tiger. For example, I have a MacBook Pro here with an optional matte screen. On that device, the ultra-matte finish completely eliminates screen reflections. However, with a phone, the angle changes constantly, and the screen often faces overhead lights. The matte finish does indeed require constant angle adjustments due to glare . In short, the matte reflection issue that has been debated abroad is real; for those who are hesitant, I suggest trying it out in person before deciding . Alright, having covered the creases, I hope that satisfies your curiosity. So, what are your thoughts on this.

iPhone Duo screen? Personally, I would hope Apple follows their iPad and MacBook product lines in the future by offering both anti-reflective glossy and matte options on the Duo, or making the matte layer a removable screen protector. That way, users could still choose between maintaining a crystal-clear glossy look or a super-matte finish for ultimate anti-reflection via a screen protector. Plus, if the screen gets scratched, a screen protector could be replaced, whereas now, a scratch is just a scratch. Alright, that wraps up the key. points on the display. As for the exterior, there are three more key points about the iPhone Duo. First, the iPhone Duo features an IP68 water resistance rating, which is relatively rare for foldables, so you don't have to worry about using it outdoors. Second, in terms of hand-feel, the presence of the iPhone is certainly quite significant. While the similarly positioned Samsung Fold4 is only 201 grams, and the larger Fold4 Ultra is 215 grams, at 225 grams, Apple’s iPhone Duo reaches a staggering 254 grams. It’s even heavier than the very heavy iPhone 16 Pro Max, which is. quite surprising, especially combined with the 8.4 cm body width. One-handed grip will be a major test, so I suggest checking in-store if your hand can manage it. Finally, the iPhone Duo only supports eSIM, so you cannot insert a physical SIM card. After purchasing, it is recommended to ensure the phone has no issues before going to the carrier store to transfer your number. Additionally, the iPhone Duo uses a long-lost Touch ID, but its speed is relatively average by 2026 standards. Interestingly, the volume buttons have been moved to the top of the body; while logically clever to suit an intuitive portrait experience, my experience so far is that there is still a learning curve to having them on top. Regarding this first foldable iPhone, let me quickly share some accessory options for the foldable. First, you can apply a glass screen protector to the outer screen. The official store sells two types of cases : one is this magnetic version. The other is a foldable-style case, which relies on adhesive strips to attach to the device body. One reminder: it is recommended not to wrap the hinge, to avoid affecting the internal structure. If you are concerned, please choose a product that offers hinge protection. Also, if your case blocks the screen, you can enable the "Adjust to Left Edge " option in settings, and the system will reformat the interface to accommodate the case. Next, the third major highlight: it’s time for our channel’s tradition of testing the display performance using equipment we’ve invested over $ 10,000 in. First, let's test brightness. Both screens on the iPhone Duo share the same brightness specs, featuring a Super Retina XDR 2 display with a rated. 1000 nits maximum brightness and 3000 nits peak outdoor brightness. After our hands-on testing, the full-screen maximum brightness for both the inner and outer displays on the iPhone Duo does indeed reach the rated 1000 nits. Furthermore, regarding peak brightness, our tests show that the iPhone Duo can reach the officially claimed 3000 nits peak brightness on 25%of the display area. Overall, Apple has maintained 1000 nits for full-screen brightness this generation, which is a bit struggling by 2026 standards. As other brands are moving toward 1500 or even 2000 nits, this is definitely a.

hardware upgrade Apple must keep up with in the next generation. It will still be a bit difficult to see under the sun, but the 3000 nits peak brightness hits flagship levels, which can effectively unlock HDR video content. In terms of color, our testing shows that this year's iPhone CCT has also followed the 16 Pro series, moving away from the traditional sRGB standard . I have provided the white point coordinates for both the inner and outer screens for your reference. Finally, we want to test the PWM for those with sensitive eyes. Apple also. provides a "Smooth PWM" option in the iPhone Duo settings. As you can see on the screen, once it's turned on, the PWM does become smoother. We are bringing out our expensive equipment to test the iPhone Duo's true PWM. But before that, since this show is always objective and thorough, please subscribe and support us. For you, subscribing is completely free, but for us, it is truly important. The results show that regardless of whether the smooth PWM is on, the actual PWM for. both screens remains 480Hz. Moving on to the experience segment, I originally intended to share the charm of foldables and how much of a gap it creates compared to traditional smartphones, as the goodness on Android is coming to iOS. However, after playing with it, the situation I was most worried about has actually happened. Most of the apps have not been optimized yet. For instance, LINE has absolutely no interface adjustments . Facebook has, but games like Genshin. Impact and Honkai: Star Rail have not been updated. Even Apple's own Apple Store hasn't been fully adapted. Come on, Apple. So I must say, evaluating this system at this point is a pity; there are too many imperfections, and it's not even ready to compete with Android. Otherwise, the opening animations and the side control interface are fresh ideas that Apple. executed well, but I think we should give it more time before a full review, or this screen is wasted. Speaking of screens, yes, this foldable screen is still very suitable. For DeskKing, the remote software I use daily, it has three key features: First, it's intuitive; you can connect to your home PC via phone or use your iPad as a secondary monitor. Second, it offers low latency, allowing me to edit videos. remotely; even complex projects work fine, and file transfer speeds are great. DeskKing also focuses on remote gaming; look at me playing games remotely on my 5090 PC with a regular laptop—the latency is quite good, with up to 4K60FPS or 2K240FPS, and it supports controllers too. Most importantly, Deskasking is a truly reliable remote software, whether you're working remotely from home or helping seniors solve phone issues. You can even use DKing for remote startup;

I'm out right now, but I just tap the remote power button in the app, and look, my home computer turns on instantly. Check out this video for the tutorial. For those interested, most features are available in the free version of DKing. For advanced needs, I recommend the Asking Gaming version as it's the most versatile. The link is in the pinned comment. Thanks again to DKing for making our production process worry-free. By the way, I look forward to the official team releasing an optimized version soon. Back to the show, next is the fifth key highlight:. charging. iPhone Du also hides a USB-C port and supports the USB 3 transfer protocol, reaching speeds of up to 10GB /second. It’s still much more convenient for transferring files. The good news is that iPhone Du also supports Apple’s latest generation fast-charging protocol. Our tests show that at low battery levels, peak wattage can reach about 36 watts. As for overall charging speed, using Apple’s original 60W dynamic charger, it takes about 30 minutes. It can charge up to 50%, and fully charge in about an hour. The total time to reach a full charge is about one hour and 17. minutes, which is slightly slower than this year's 18 Pro series. However, it is still faster in charging speed than any model prior to the 17 Pro series. Alright, let's move on to the sixth highlight: performance. As Apple’s first foldable flagship, iPhone Duo definitely uses the exceptionally powerful Apple A20 Pro chip, paired with generous memory. If you want a deeper understanding of this great piece of tech, feel free to check out our final iPhone 18 Pro series review, where there is a more detailed analysis. . In this episode, we will only verify one question. Is there any gap in peak performance compared to the iPhone 18 Pro series? First, our tests show that the iPhone's single-core and multi-core performance, while slightly lower in comparison, basically reaches the same top-tier level as the thermally improved iPhone 18 Pro series in GB7 peak benchmarks. However, looking at the more GPU-intensive 3DMark Solar Bay test, the iPhone Duo shows about a 3.5% difference in peak performance. As for. connectivity, the iPhone Duo is fully equipped with the self-developed C2 + N1 chip, supporting advanced specifications like 5G, Wi-Fi 7, and BLE 6.0. Without further ado, let’s jump into the gaming and stress test segment. That’s right, even though time is tight, we still ran a full session of Honkai: Star Rail. We also ran Honkai: Star Rail at max settings for 30 minutes. Our tests show that due to the folding mechanism's limited heat dissipation, the iPhone Duo struggles more than the 18 Pro. On the outer. screen, it averaged 58.83 FPS throughout, with 1%lows dropping to 29.3 FPS. The key point is that while the front stayed at a manageable 40 ° C, the back couldn't handle it, reaching a high of 46 ° C. We ran the same test on the inner screen, where the iPhone Duo averaged 58.85 FPS with 1%lows of 29.5 FPS. The real highlight is that when unfolded, both front and back temperatures hit 43 ° C, which is.

still slightly on the high side. In any case, we are currently deep into comprehensive testing for the iPhone, and I will provide full updates in the complete review. Let's move to our final focus: the camera. This year's iPhone Duo packs a 48MP main lens and a 48MP ultra-wide lens that doubles as a macro lens. It has a 12MP Stage selfie lens. Paired with an under-display lens . Honestly, the image quality of that. internal lens is basically webcam-level , and you can see the pixels in the under-display area with the naked eye. For selfies, I recommend using the outer screen or the main rear lens. It basically lacks a telephoto lens, and the main and selfie lenses differ slightly from the Pro series. But you should have known that when you chose the iPhone Duo. It was never meant to be a device that prioritizes a flagship camera system. The interesting part of the iPhone Duo lies in the various unique features exclusive to foldable devices. For example, simultaneous previews on the inner and outer screens. allow the person being photographed to see themselves and adjust their pose. Or, you can use the "Look Here" feature to grab a child's attention, or open the camera on the outer screen, unfold the device, and slide the camera view across the screen. See? Now we can use the rear main lens and ultra-wide lens to take selfies. As Apple's first foldable phone, they opted for a free-stop hinge, so you can set it on a table for hands-free selfies. Apple even provides features like Center. Stage and Smart Framing, where the system automatically frames shots based on your movements, making it quite fun. One thing to note is the orientation of the sensors. In fact, when you hold the iPhone Duo vertically, you are actually taking landscape photos. When you hold it horizontally, you are taking portrait photos, so you'll need to get used to it. Furthermore, in terms of functionality, although it lacks the shutter speed and aperture adjustments of the Pro series, the camera interface still allows for basic functions like. manual focus and white balance adjustment. Besides that, this iPhone also supports the Pro series 'Cinematic mode and 4K 120fps recording on the main lens, though the ultra-wide lens is limited to 4K 60fps. Alright, coming to the final conclusion, after getting my hands on this year's iPhone, I feel the current situation is quite clear. You can always trust Apple's craftsmanship and their design in areas they have full control over. In terms of the system, the iPhone perfectly reflects the quality expected from. Apple. At the same time, we’ve been testing foldable phones for years; starting from the first Samsung foldable, we’ve tried our best to test all the major ones that have come out. Long-time viewers know that we often share time and time again that a foldable is a product that cannot be built solely by stacking hardware specs . Software optimization is the core of foldable phones and it requires time to polish. For example, multi-window multitasking and the foldable keyboard. These are still in the exploration stage, which is the current state of this iPhone. Since Apple has completely overhauled the operating logic, we have.

to give it a little more time. I also want to experience it for a while longer, so be sure to come back for the full review. For those interested but who didn't manage to grab one at launch , there are three things you should check: first, can you truly accept the weight and the in-hand feel? Second, does the matte reflection issue on the screen interfere with your experience? If you are sensitive to display quality , you will indeed need to keep adjusting the viewing angle. Finally, take some time to confirm whether the software has been properly optimized. for this iPhone. For those who did manage to grab one, a quick heads-up: heat dissipation is indeed relatively limited. You will feel significant warmth during initial setup, but it’s within expectations, so no need to worry too much. Furthermore, the current system doesn't feel stable enough yet. For instance, we've encountered screen flickering when opening the camera, and the camera view freezing completely. It even showed a " non-genuine lens" warning, requiring a restart to return to normal. It might need an update, so let us take our time. and share the full test results with you later. Alright, that's it for the show, thanks to everyone for watching this far. Producing this content isn't easy, so your support is appreciated. You’re also welcome to join as a channel member or use the YouTube Super Thanks button to sponsor us in creating more valuable hands-on shows. If you have any questions, feel free to leave them in the comments below. I’m LuZi. See you next time. If you enjoyed this episode, don't forget to subscribe to Bunny, and turn on the notification bell to receive updates on our latest reviews. Of course, you can also find. us on Facebook at Bunny Assistant, Instagram, and Line.

item.title: 「邦尼評測」必看！新世代頂級 OLED！非常強？LG OLED evo AI G6 完整評測（實測破 5000 尼特峰值、零間隙壁掛、五年面板保固、優缺點、亮度色域色準 LG OLED電視推薦？

item.itunes:author: 邦尼幫你 3C 科技 - 開箱評測
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2Tw81K6jEq4

值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入了解 LG 最新旗艦 OLED 電視 LG OLED Evo AI G6 所搭載的突破性技術，特別是峰值亮度如何跨越 5,000 nits 大關。
  • 解析全新 RBGB 四層串聯架構（PM-OLED RGB Tandem 2.0）與傳統架構的差異，了解其如何兼顧更高發光效率、低功耗與優異色彩表現。
  • 揭秘 LG 獨家的全新 Reflection Free Premium 抗反射技術，如何在維持純淨鏡面畫質的同時大幅消除惱人反光。
  • 獲得 77 吋 LG G6 與 C6 在外觀設計、壁掛與桌架適用性、連接埠配置及專屬智慧遙控器功能的完整開箱分析。

摘要

突破極限的發光架構與驚人亮度表現

作者隆重介紹了 LG 全新的旗艦級電視 LG OLED Evo AI G6，其最受矚目的亮點在於採用新一代旗艦級 OLED 面板，將電視的發光表現推向嶄新高度。這款顯示器搭載了 PM-OLED RGB Tandem 2.0 技術，將以往透過彩色濾光片顯色的三層 BYB 架構，升級為效率更高的 RBGB（紅-藍-綠-藍）四層串聯結構。透過分散發光負載，不僅大幅減輕了各發光層的壓力與總功耗，更有效解決了高亮度下的色彩淡化與偏移問題。實測顯示，G6 在 1% 視窗下的峰值亮度突破了 5,000 nits，能正面迎戰國際品牌的頂級 Mini-LED 機種；而在極考驗 OLED 實力的全螢幕亮度上，77 吋版本也達到了 400 nits 以上，足以勝任開燈觀影與各類客廳家庭娛樂需求。

鏡面抗反光技術的革命性突破

除了驚豔的亮度，作者指出 G6 另一項重大革新是導入了 Reflection Free Premium 新一代抗反射技術。不同於業界普遍採用會略微犧牲畫質純淨度的極細霧面塗層，LG 在保留透亮鏡面質感的同時，實現了極致的抗眩光效果。經過手電筒照射實測對比，以往頂級鏡面旗艦常出現的彩色條狀反光，在 G6 上被大幅收斂至極小範圍的微弱紫光，即使在強烈環境光下也不會看到觀影者自身的倒影，完美平衡了通透鮮豔的視覺感受與出色的抗反光能力。

旗艦外觀工藝、零貼牆設計與齊全擴充配置

在機身外觀與硬體配置上，77 吋的 LG G6 採用三邊窄邊框設計（約 6 至 7mm），底邊厚度僅 14.7mm，並將指示燈與實體按鍵巧妙隱藏。為了呈現宛如壁畫般的視覺效果，G6 採用全金屬背板並將總厚度控制在極為輕薄的 2.6 公分，包裝內標配專屬的零間隙壁掛架，可完全貼平牆面；若選擇桌面擺放，亦可選購具備晃動緩衝設計的精緻拉絲金屬底座。連接介面方面，G6 配備了多達 4 組高速 HDMI 2.1 連接埠，全部原生支援 120Hz 以及透過 DSC 實現的 4K 165Hz 高更新率，並提供 3 組 USB-A、光纖輸出、5GHz Wi-Fi 與藍牙 5.3。作者同時對比了同系列的 LG C6，指出 C6 採用超薄螢幕搭配主機背包結構，更適合桌面擺放；而 G6 的平整化機身則是壁掛安裝的首選。

直覺便利的 AI 智慧魔術遙控器

作者最後評測了隨機附贈的藍牙智慧遙控器。該遙控器無須對準螢幕即可靈敏操作，並支援語音聲控功能。遙控器核心配置了便於瀏覽 Netflix 等影音串流的四向鍵與招牌滾輪設計，內部更整合了陀螺儀感應器，讓使用者能夠像揮動「魔法棒」般利用螢幕虛擬游標快速點選功能。此外，遙控器下半部還內建了 Netflix、Prime Video、Disney+ 與 YouTube 等主流串流平台的快捷按鈕，為用戶提供極致便捷的操作體驗。

================================================

It's finally here. Right behind me is. LG’s latest OLED Evo flagship display. , the LG OLED Evo AI G6. The biggest. highlight is that LG has used their new. generation flagship OLED panel, which. features a peak brightness breaking. through 5,000 nits. It’s definitely. worth a look. Hi, welcome back. I’m. Donkey. The attention surrounding. LG’s flagship OLEDs this year is. arguably higher than in previous years,. primarily because both the flagship G6. and the high-value, high-end large-size. C6 models feature what the company. calls "Hyper-Radian Color Tech," the. new generation of OLED display. technology. However, the core. principles driving LG’s so-called " Hyper-Radian Color Tech" can be. categorized into the new generation LG. OLED panel, the new AI processor, new. anti-reflective technology, and new. color and brightness control algorithms. . There are five main aspects in total,. and putting them all together captures. the essence of this generation. First,. let’s talk about the new generation. flagship OLED panel. In fact, the LG G6. uses an OLED panel featuring the. PM-OLED RGB Tandem 2.0 technology from. LG, which we’ve introduced before and. offers incredibly strong performance. So, what’s the difference? I’ll. just do a quick recap here. LG’s. PM-OLED RGB Tandem 2.0 still uses a. multi-layer tandem OLED hardware. solution, but in terms of stacking, it. has moved from the previous BYB (. Blue-Yellow-Blue) three-layer stack,. which achieved green and red through. color filtering. This year, it has been. directly changed to an RBGB (. 值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入了解 LG 最新旗艦 OLED 電視 LG OLED Evo AI G6 所搭載的突破性技術，特別是峰值亮度如何跨越 5,000 nits 大關。
  • 解析全新 RBGB 四層串聯架構（PM-OLED RGB Tandem 2.0）與傳統架構的差異，了解其如何兼顧更高發光效率、低功耗與優異色彩表現。
  • 揭秘 LG 獨家的全新 Reflection Free Premium 抗反射技術，如何在維持純淨鏡面畫質的同時大幅消除惱人反光。
  • 獲得 77 吋 LG G6 與 C6 在外觀設計、壁掛與桌架適用性、連接埠配置及專屬智慧遙控器功能的完整開箱分析。

摘要

突破極限的發光架構與驚人亮度表現

作者隆重介紹了 LG 全新的旗艦級電視 LG OLED Evo AI G6，其最受矚目的亮點在於採用新一代旗艦級 OLED 面板，將電視的發光表現推向嶄新高度。這款顯示器搭載了 PM-OLED RGB Tandem 2.0 技術，將以往透過彩色濾光片顯色的三層 BYB 架構，升級為效率更高的 RBGB（紅-藍-綠-藍）四層串聯結構。透過分散發光負載，不僅大幅減輕了各發光層的壓力與總功耗，更有效解決了高亮度下的色彩淡化與偏移問題。實測顯示，G6 在 1% 視窗下的峰值亮度突破了 5,000 nits，能正面迎戰國際品牌的頂級 Mini-LED 機種；而在極考驗 OLED 實力的全螢幕亮度上，77 吋版本也達到了 400 nits 以上，足以勝任開燈觀影與各類客廳家庭娛樂需求。

鏡面抗反光技術的革命性突破

除了驚豔的亮度，作者指出 G6 另一項重大革新是導入了 Reflection Free Premium 新一代抗反射技術。不同於業界普遍採用會略微犧牲畫質純淨度的極細霧面塗層，LG 在保留透亮鏡面質感的同時，實現了極致的抗眩光效果。經過手電筒照射實測對比，以往頂級鏡面旗艦常出現的彩色條狀反光，在 G6 上被大幅收斂至極小範圍的微弱紫光，即使在強烈環境光下也不會看到觀影者自身的倒影，完美平衡了通透鮮豔的視覺感受與出色的抗反光能力。

旗艦外觀工藝、零貼牆設計與齊全擴充配置

在機身外觀與硬體配置上，77 吋的 LG G6 採用三邊窄邊框設計（約 6 至 7mm），底邊厚度僅 14.7mm，並將指示燈與實體按鍵巧妙隱藏。為了呈現宛如壁畫般的視覺效果，G6 採用全金屬背板並將總厚度控制在極為輕薄的 2.6 公分，包裝內標配專屬的零間隙壁掛架，可完全貼平牆面；若選擇桌面擺放，亦可選購具備晃動緩衝設計的精緻拉絲金屬底座。連接介面方面，G6 配備了多達 4 組高速 HDMI 2.1 連接埠，全部原生支援 120Hz 以及透過 DSC 實現的 4K 165Hz 高更新率，並提供 3 組 USB-A、光纖輸出、5GHz Wi-Fi 與藍牙 5.3。作者同時對比了同系列的 LG C6，指出 C6 採用超薄螢幕搭配主機背包結構，更適合桌面擺放；而 G6 的平整化機身則是壁掛安裝的首選。

直覺便利的 AI 智慧魔術遙控器

作者最後評測了隨機附贈的藍牙智慧遙控器。該遙控器無須對準螢幕即可靈敏操作，並支援語音聲控功能。遙控器核心配置了便於瀏覽 Netflix 等影音串流的四向鍵與招牌滾輪設計，內部更整合了陀螺儀感應器，讓使用者能夠像揮動「魔法棒」般利用螢幕虛擬游標快速點選功能。此外，遙控器下半部還內建了 Netflix、Prime Video、Disney+ 與 YouTube 等主流串流平台的快捷按鈕，為用戶提供極致便捷的操作體驗。

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2Tw81K6jEq4

值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入了解 LG 最新旗艦 OLED 電視 LG OLED Evo AI G6 所搭載的突破性技術，特別是峰值亮度如何跨越 5,000 nits 大關。
  • 解析全新 RBGB 四層串聯架構（PM-OLED RGB Tandem 2.0）與傳統架構的差異，了解其如何兼顧更高發光效率、低功耗與優異色彩表現。
  • 揭秘 LG 獨家的全新 Reflection Free Premium 抗反射技術，如何在維持純淨鏡面畫質的同時大幅消除惱人反光。
  • 獲得 77 吋 LG G6 與 C6 在外觀設計、壁掛與桌架適用性、連接埠配置及專屬智慧遙控器功能的完整開箱分析。

摘要

突破極限的發光架構與驚人亮度表現

作者隆重介紹了 LG 全新的旗艦級電視 LG OLED Evo AI G6，其最受矚目的亮點在於採用新一代旗艦級 OLED 面板，將電視的發光表現推向嶄新高度。這款顯示器搭載了 PM-OLED RGB Tandem 2.0 技術，將以往透過彩色濾光片顯色的三層 BYB 架構，升級為效率更高的 RBGB（紅-藍-綠-藍）四層串聯結構。透過分散發光負載，不僅大幅減輕了各發光層的壓力與總功耗，更有效解決了高亮度下的色彩淡化與偏移問題。實測顯示，G6 在 1% 視窗下的峰值亮度突破了 5,000 nits，能正面迎戰國際品牌的頂級 Mini-LED 機種；而在極考驗 OLED 實力的全螢幕亮度上，77 吋版本也達到了 400 nits 以上，足以勝任開燈觀影與各類客廳家庭娛樂需求。

鏡面抗反光技術的革命性突破

除了驚豔的亮度，作者指出 G6 另一項重大革新是導入了 Reflection Free Premium 新一代抗反射技術。不同於業界普遍採用會略微犧牲畫質純淨度的極細霧面塗層，LG 在保留透亮鏡面質感的同時，實現了極致的抗眩光效果。經過手電筒照射實測對比，以往頂級鏡面旗艦常出現的彩色條狀反光，在 G6 上被大幅收斂至極小範圍的微弱紫光，即使在強烈環境光下也不會看到觀影者自身的倒影，完美平衡了通透鮮豔的視覺感受與出色的抗反光能力。

旗艦外觀工藝、零貼牆設計與齊全擴充配置

在機身外觀與硬體配置上，77 吋的 LG G6 採用三邊窄邊框設計（約 6 至 7mm），底邊厚度僅 14.7mm，並將指示燈與實體按鍵巧妙隱藏。為了呈現宛如壁畫般的視覺效果，G6 採用全金屬背板並將總厚度控制在極為輕薄的 2.6 公分，包裝內標配專屬的零間隙壁掛架，可完全貼平牆面；若選擇桌面擺放，亦可選購具備晃動緩衝設計的精緻拉絲金屬底座。連接介面方面，G6 配備了多達 4 組高速 HDMI 2.1 連接埠，全部原生支援 120Hz 以及透過 DSC 實現的 4K 165Hz 高更新率，並提供 3 組 USB-A、光纖輸出、5GHz Wi-Fi 與藍牙 5.3。作者同時對比了同系列的 LG C6，指出 C6 採用超薄螢幕搭配主機背包結構，更適合桌面擺放；而 G6 的平整化機身則是壁掛安裝的首選。

直覺便利的 AI 智慧魔術遙控器

作者最後評測了隨機附贈的藍牙智慧遙控器。該遙控器無須對準螢幕即可靈敏操作，並支援語音聲控功能。遙控器核心配置了便於瀏覽 Netflix 等影音串流的四向鍵與招牌滾輪設計，內部更整合了陀螺儀感應器，讓使用者能夠像揮動「魔法棒」般利用螢幕虛擬游標快速點選功能。此外，遙控器下半部還內建了 Netflix、Prime Video、Disney+ 與 YouTube 等主流串流平台的快捷按鈕，為用戶提供極致便捷的操作體驗。

================================================

It's finally here. Right behind me is. LG’s latest OLED Evo flagship display. , the LG OLED Evo AI G6. The biggest. highlight is that LG has used their new. generation flagship OLED panel, which. features a peak brightness breaking. through 5,000 nits. It’s definitely. worth a look. Hi, welcome back. I’m. Donkey. The attention surrounding. LG’s flagship OLEDs this year is. arguably higher than in previous years,. primarily because both the flagship G6. and the high-value, high-end large-size. C6 models feature what the company. calls "Hyper-Radian Color Tech," the. new generation of OLED display. technology. However, the core. principles driving LG’s so-called " Hyper-Radian Color Tech" can be. categorized into the new generation LG. OLED panel, the new AI processor, new. anti-reflective technology, and new. color and brightness control algorithms. . There are five main aspects in total,. and putting them all together captures. the essence of this generation. First,. let’s talk about the new generation. flagship OLED panel. In fact, the LG G6. uses an OLED panel featuring the. PM-OLED RGB Tandem 2.0 technology from. LG, which we’ve introduced before and. offers incredibly strong performance. So, what’s the difference? I’ll. just do a quick recap here. LG’s. PM-OLED RGB Tandem 2.0 still uses a. multi-layer tandem OLED hardware. solution, but in terms of stacking, it. has moved from the previous BYB (. Blue-Yellow-Blue) three-layer stack,. which achieved green and red through. color filtering. This year, it has been. directly changed to an RBGB (. Red-Blue-Green-Blue) four-layer stack. with higher luminous efficiency. Compared to the previous three-layer. version, this new RBGB four-layer stack. allows the new OLED panel to achieve. higher overall luminous efficiency. while under relatively lower layer. stress. In plain terms, instead of. pushing every layer to its limit for. high brightness, the luminous load is. distributed, allowing all four layers. to operate in a more energy-efficient. and effective light-emitting state. This is why LG OLEDs this year can. achieve higher screen brightness while. reducing power consumption, and. compared to traditional WOLED solutions. , there is a significant boost in color. performance. Alright, that opening was. a bit too detailed. Looking at the. final results, there are three main. points to remember. First, the overall. equivalent power consumption of the new. generation has dropped significantly. So, at the same brightness level, it is. much better for power supply longevity. and thermal pressure. Second, the new. generation’s four-layer stack further. mitigates color desaturation and. shifting issues often seen under high. brightness and strong ambient light. However, I think for most users, the. biggest improvement in the new. generation of LG OLEDs is definitely. the screen brightness. So, without. further ado, let’s get straight to. the testing. The G6 this year is truly,. truly impressive in terms of brightness. . At a 1%window, the peak brightness. can actually soar past 5,000 nits. Looking at the data, it can directly. compete with the brightness performance. of most flagship Mini-LED TVs from. international brands. For an OLED, this. level of performance was previously. unimaginable; it’s quite. extraordinary. However, those in the. know understand that we also need to.

look at full-screen brightness, which. is much harder for OLEDs to achieve. In. our tests, the 77-inch version of the. G6 we have on hand is already capable. of reaching over 400 nits of brightness. this generation. This 400 nits on the. 77-inch model basically means that for. this generation of G6, even if placed. in a living room for family. entertainment, watching shows with the. lights on, or viewing TV and animation,. it is already more than sufficient. The. main point I want to emphasize is that. this generation of G6 has another very. noticeable upgrade: the official. implementation of the new generation. Reflection Free Premium technology. The. coolest part is that while everyone. else is moving toward ultra-fine matte. finishes for anti-reflection, LG seems. unwilling to compromise; this. generation manages to maintain a glossy. surface while delivering extremely. strong anti-reflective performance. Seeing is believing, so let’s go. ahead and do our usual flashlight test. You can clearly see the comparison on. screen; previous top-tier glossy. flagships from other brands would, at. the very least, still have that strip. of color glare typical of. anti-reflective screens. That unit is. already quite good, but the LG G6 has. managed to reduce it to a tiny range of. purple light. It's very, very. impressive; basically, you won't be. watching a show and suddenly see your. own reflection in the middle of it. Strictly speaking, while there is still. a tiny hint of a matte feel under. strong light, it is definitely not the. ultra-fine matte coating that is. popular right now. It is still. essentially a glossy screen, so the. entire image remains extremely clear. and vibrant. A few days ago, when I. walked past the G6, I unintentionally. realized there was absolutely no. reflection. In short, for friends who. like watching TV with the lights on and. prefer a glossy screen but still want. anti-reflective effects, this year’s. G6 is definitely worth experiencing in. person. Alright, the intro has been too. long, so let’s stop here. Just how. well does this flagship equipped with. LG’s new generation OLED panel. actually perform? Let’s find out. together. First of all, we are unboxing. two units today: the. flagship-positioned LG OLED evo AI G6. and the high-value, high-end LG OLED. evo AI C6. We will refer to them as G6. and C for short from now on. This video. will primarily focus on the G6. performance tests. Alright, let’s. start by taking a look at the design. The 77-inch LG G6 we have uses a. standard three-sided narrow bezel. design. The three-sided bezel is about. 6 to 7mm, while the bottom is around. 14.7 mm, meeting the narrow bezel. standards for large-sized TVs. As for. the configuration, LG placed the. indicator light in the center of the. bottom; the LED stays on when powered. off and turns off automatically when. powered on to avoid distracting the. viewer. Additionally, the G6 retains a. physical button on the bottom right,. which comes in handy if you can't find. the remote. Regarding installation,. this year's G6 is specifically designed. for flush wall mounting, so a flush. wall mount is included in the box by. default. But if you prefer a tabletop. setup, you can still purchase an. additional custom-made metal flat base. LG adopted a modern, sleek beveled. design, featuring a refined brushed.

finish on the surface. The right side. features the LG OLED icon. From the. front, the overall flagship feel is. consistently on point. Furthermore, LG. also incorporated some sway tolerance. into the base design. So, if we give it. a slight push to shake it. You can see. it has a natural oscillation to reduce. the chance of it tipping over, but. honestly, if you have the means with a. large TV, I still recommend wall. mounting for the best peace of mind. The key point is that the G6 uses a. large, custom-fit metal back panel,. which not only enhances heat. dissipation but also ensures sufficient. structural rigidity. And it would be a. real pity to buy a G6 and not. wall-mount it. After all, in terms of. hardware, LG has already reserved space. for the flush wall mount, and as the. flagship model, LG kept the total. thickness with the back panel at around. 2.6 cm, which is very sleek. So, this. flush-mount design makes it look like a. screen resting quietly on the wall,. rather than a bulky TV sticking out. For those with specific wall-mounting. needs, the G6 also provides a VESA. 300x300 specification. As for the I/O. ports, the power connector is in the. middle, allowing it to hide naturally. behind the base without affecting the. front view. The signal ports are on the. left side when facing it, featuring two. USB-A ports from top to bottom,. followed by four high-speed HDMI 2.1. ports, which is very impressive; all. four support native 120Hz or DSC 4K. 165Hz high refresh rates, a big plus. For those connecting a home theater, be. sure to use the correct HDMI port. LG. even included a third USB-A port, an. RJ45 Ethernet jack, and an optical port. ; additionally, the G6 supports. high-speed 5GHz WiFi and Bluetooth 5.3. And for the LG C6, we also received the. 77-inch version. problem at all. Next, we will move. directly into the hands-on testing. segment that everyone is looking. forward to. 值得閱讀的理由

  • 一次掌握 Honor Magic V3 的輕薄設計、旗艦規格與相機配置。
  • 了解大摺疊手機在螢幕、電池、耐用性與日常使用上的實際體驗。
  • 整理作者對摺痕、配件及購機保固方案的觀察，方便評估是否適合入手。

摘要

旗艦規格塞進超薄摺疊機身

作者介紹 Honor Magic V3，指出它在維持旗艦硬體的同時，打造出極薄的摺疊機身。手機搭載高通 Snapdragon 8 Gen 3、16GB LPDDR5X 記憶體與 512GB 儲存空間，並配置 5150mAh 矽碳電池，支援 66W 有線及 50W 無線快充。相機方面則有 5000 萬畫素主鏡頭、超廣角微距鏡頭，以及支援 3.5 倍光學變焦的潛望式長焦鏡頭。

輕薄手感與購機保障

作者提到，Magic V3 的機身厚度約為 9.2 毫米，白色版本的數據則為 8.75 毫米，重量依版本約為 219 至 226 克，與 iPhone 16 Pro 系列相比也相當輕薄。展開後，手機提供近 8 吋的大螢幕，合起來仍可作為日常手機使用。作者也介紹上市優惠：在指定期限前購買，可獲一年延長保固與一年意外損壞保障；不過免費維修是否另收工資，仍有待確認。

外觀、摺痕與機身設計

白色版本採用航空級特殊纖維背蓋，搭配八角形相機模組與亮面轉軸。作者認為，近年大摺疊手機已大幅減輕、變薄，展開後的大螢幕也帶來一般手機難以取代的使用體驗。至於螢幕摺痕，作者表示 Magic V3 的表現符合現代摺疊機水準，略深於摺痕控制出色的 Galaxy Z Fold 6，但仍優於部分較早期機型；出廠預貼的抗反光保護膜，也能讓摺痕在展開時不那麼明顯。轉軸手感比前代紮實，並通過 SGS 50 萬次摺疊測試。

連接功能與盒裝配件

手機的電源鍵整合指紋辨識，底部 SIM 卡槽可放入兩張實體 SIM 卡，並支援 eSIM，方便旅行使用；機身頂部也配有紅外線發射器，可用來控制家電。盒裝內含充電器，以及附有支架與鏡頭保護設計的保護殼。作者認為，這些配件對日常使用相當實用。

內外螢幕與亮度實測

外螢幕為 6.43 吋 FHD+ OLED，內螢幕則為 7.92 吋 OLED，兩者皆支援 1 至 120Hz LTPO 更新率與最高 5000 尼特標示亮度；內螢幕採用超薄玻璃，兩面螢幕也都支援全螢幕 AOD。外螢幕另使用 Honor 的抗反光玻璃方案，作者指出它比一般亮面螢幕更不易反光，並具備較好的耐刮與抗摔能力。實測中，外螢幕峰值亮度達 5900 尼特，強光下全螢幕亮度為 2060 尼特；內螢幕峰值亮度則達 5340 尼特，全螢幕亮度為 1330 尼特，戶外使用有一定優勢。

螢幕色彩測試尚未完成

作者最後開始測試螢幕色彩準確度，並說明 Magic V3 提供標準、鮮豔與專業三種顯示模式。影片字幕在介紹各模式測試時中止，因此尚未呈現完整的色彩測量結果。

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o9t4v-FZh3s

值得閱讀的理由

  • 一次掌握 Honor Magic V3 的輕薄設計、旗艦規格與相機配置。
  • 了解大摺疊手機在螢幕、電池、耐用性與日常使用上的實際體驗。
  • 整理作者對摺痕、配件及購機保固方案的觀察，方便評估是否適合入手。

摘要

旗艦規格塞進超薄摺疊機身

作者介紹 Honor Magic V3，指出它在維持旗艦硬體的同時，打造出極薄的摺疊機身。手機搭載高通 Snapdragon 8 Gen 3、16GB LPDDR5X 記憶體與 512GB 儲存空間，並配置 5150mAh 矽碳電池，支援 66W 有線及 50W 無線快充。相機方面則有 5000 萬畫素主鏡頭、超廣角微距鏡頭，以及支援 3.5 倍光學變焦的潛望式長焦鏡頭。

輕薄手感與購機保障

作者提到，Magic V3 的機身厚度約為 9.2 毫米，白色版本的數據則為 8.75 毫米，重量依版本約為 219 至 226 克，與 iPhone 16 Pro 系列相比也相當輕薄。展開後，手機提供近 8 吋的大螢幕，合起來仍可作為日常手機使用。作者也介紹上市優惠：在指定期限前購買，可獲一年延長保固與一年意外損壞保障；不過免費維修是否另收工資，仍有待確認。

外觀、摺痕與機身設計

白色版本採用航空級特殊纖維背蓋，搭配八角形相機模組與亮面轉軸。作者認為，近年大摺疊手機已大幅減輕、變薄，展開後的大螢幕也帶來一般手機難以取代的使用體驗。至於螢幕摺痕，作者表示 Magic V3 的表現符合現代摺疊機水準，略深於摺痕控制出色的 Galaxy Z Fold 6，但仍優於部分較早期機型；出廠預貼的抗反光保護膜，也能讓摺痕在展開時不那麼明顯。轉軸手感比前代紮實，並通過 SGS 50 萬次摺疊測試。

連接功能與盒裝配件

手機的電源鍵整合指紋辨識，底部 SIM 卡槽可放入兩張實體 SIM 卡，並支援 eSIM，方便旅行使用；機身頂部也配有紅外線發射器，可用來控制家電。盒裝內含充電器，以及附有支架與鏡頭保護設計的保護殼。作者認為，這些配件對日常使用相當實用。

內外螢幕與亮度實測

外螢幕為 6.43 吋 FHD+ OLED，內螢幕則為 7.92 吋 OLED，兩者皆支援 1 至 120Hz LTPO 更新率與最高 5000 尼特標示亮度；內螢幕採用超薄玻璃，兩面螢幕也都支援全螢幕 AOD。外螢幕另使用 Honor 的抗反光玻璃方案，作者指出它比一般亮面螢幕更不易反光，並具備較好的耐刮與抗摔能力。實測中，外螢幕峰值亮度達 5900 尼特，強光下全螢幕亮度為 2060 尼特；內螢幕峰值亮度則達 5340 尼特，全螢幕亮度為 1330 尼特，戶外使用有一定優勢。

螢幕色彩測試尚未完成

作者最後開始測試螢幕色彩準確度，並說明 Magic V3 提供標準、鮮豔與專業三種顯示模式。影片字幕在介紹各模式測試時中止，因此尚未呈現完整的色彩測量結果。
