Additionally, you. can customize what happens after. closing the screen: whether it. automatically switches to the outer. display, stays on while you're looking. at it and turns off when you're not, or. always stays off. Returning to the. point, I think the biggest reason why. large-screen phones have always had a. loyal user base is that, with a large. screen, scenarios that were once. possible but impractical on a phone now. become quite comfortable. For example,. the most common example I use is that. you can edit videos, open Excel, or. create PowerPoint presentations on a. regular phone; you can even split the. screen to open Word on top and Gemini. on the bottom. However, because the. screen is too small, the experience. isn't actually good, which is why I say. it's possible but not practical. But on. a foldable, the situation is different. When working on a report while using AI. , you can see I have my notes open on. the left and Gemini on the right, with. plenty of display area on both sides. Combined with the clipboard feature in. Gboard, I just need to copy the key. points on the left—copy, copy, copy. Then paste, paste, paste on the right,. and the report is done. Next, let's. look at performance. We specifically. asked Honor to provide us with a. brand-new, unsealed retail unit, just. to be transparent for your. consideration. The Honor Magic V3 in. your hands is powered by Qualcomm's. flagship Snapdragon 8 Elite chip, which. is performing exceptionally well this. year and utilizes TSMC's 3nm process. Before the V 3's successor arrives, it. remains the top of the line, using the. full eight-core Snapdragon 8 Elite. We. won't waste any more time; let's head. straight into the gaming benchmarks. We. are conducting all tests at a. consistent room temperature of 26. degrees Celsius. First, let's warm up. by running Genshin Impact in Sumeru. We're testing the Magic V 3's inner. screen, and it manages to run smoothly. at 60 FPS, with 1%lows reaching 55.3. FPS, which is extremely stable. However. , the V 3’s device temperature is on. the higher side, hitting around 45 to. 47 degrees, which is normal for a. foldable pushing peak performance. Next. , we'll jump straight into running the. more graphically demanding Honkai: Star. Rail at the highest settings. In Honkai. : Star Rail, the V 6's outer screen can. maintain an average of 53.6 fps. As you. can see on the screen, the V6 also uses. a stepped frame rate limit, so compared. to irregular drops that fluctuate. wildly, the V 6's experience is much. smoother and avoids sudden stutters. At. this point, the front and back. temperatures are between 42 and 45. degrees, and on the inner screen, the. V6 averages 52.88 fps using the same. tuning strategy; although the average. is similar to the outer screen, it. stays above 45 fps, so the experience. is actually a bit better. The device. temperature is around 44 to 46 degrees. at this stage. Overall, the Magic V6 is. likely one of the few flagship. foldables currently available in Taiwan. that dares to target gamers. But of. course, the thermal performance of a. foldable simply cannot compare to a. standard phone. Next, let's test. battery life. One of the highlights of. the Magic V6 is that Honor used a 5,600. mAh high-density battery, which is very.

large for an international foldable,. arguably packing the biggest capacity. into the thinnest device in Taiwan. Let's start by testing the outer screen. . With the 120Hz refresh rate enabled,. the Magic V 6's default performance. profile is conservative, allowing it to. achieve 17 hours and 46 minutes in the. PCMark 3.1 battery test. The inner. screen achieved 11 hours and 36 minutes. , so the Magic V 6’s battery life is. quite impressive, and for a balanced. split of inner and outer screen usage,. the 5,600 mAh capacity is definitely a. strong point. If you are a heavy user,. the Magic V6 also supports 80W wired. charging and even 66W wireless fast. charging, with the option to enable. reverse wireless charging as well. In. our 0 to 100%wired fast charging test,. the Magic V6 reaches 52%in half an hour. and 95%in one hour. A full charge takes. 69 minutes, which is quite fast. In. terms of connectivity, testing confirms. that the Magic V6 can successfully. connect to 6GHz Wi-Fi networks. Beyond. Google Wallet contactless payments via. NFC, the Honor Wallet app also supports. popular door access features; for. security, it has a physical fingerprint. sensor that unlocks with a light touch,. as well as fast facial recognition. Finally, let’s spend a moment talking. about AI. As I mentioned when I first. got hands-on with the Magic V6 at MWC,. Honor's international system features a. quite comprehensive set of AI functions. . Let me quickly go over the Magic V3. first. Besides supporting. Google-related AI like Gemini Circle to. Search, it also features HONOR's own. series of AI capabilities. For instance. , the AI photo editing suite includes. AI Eraser, AI Super Resolution, Smart. Cutout, AI Expand, AI Style, and more. Beyond the gallery, there's AI Portal,. which you can trigger with a. three-finger swipe. There is also an AI. sidebar. And the handy Magic Text,. which lets you quickly extract the text. strings you need from images. Additionally, there are AI Subtitles,. AI Translation, AI Call Translation,. and AI Notes. Let AI help you. transcribe meeting content into text. and summarize the key points. It also. includes AI Face Swap, AI Deepfake. Detection, and AI Writing Assistant,. making it one of the more AI-rich. offerings in the international market. right now. Furthermore, the V3 supports. iPhone connectivity along with. HONOR’s signature smart sensing and. air gestures. You can face the screen. and use your five fingers to swipe. through your phone mid-air while. cooking, scrolling up or down. It’s. great for scrolling through IG reels; when you see one you like, you can make. a gesture and pinch. Perform an air. gesture to take a screenshot. You can. also use air gestures to go back, which. is a signature HONOR feature. Finally. Let’s look at one of the highlights. of the Magic V3: the camera. The. overall quality of the lenses on the. Magic V3 this time is actually quite. solid. It’s well-equipped, with the. main lens featuring a 1/1.56-inch 50MP. sensor. The main lens is paired with a. 1/2.88-inch 50MP ultra-wide lens that. also functions as a macro. And lastly,. the 1/2.51-inch 64MP 3.5 x periscope. telephoto lens—still relatively rare. in foldables—is a significant upgrade. compared to the 1/3-inch or even. smaller sensors found in many other. foldables. Regarding camera modes,. since this is a quick overview of the. HONOR flagship, overall, HONOR's camera.

features are quite rich, including. Portrait mode, Night mode, Pro mode,. Light Painting, Super Macro, High. Resolution, Scanning, and the recently. popular Stage mode. In terms of video,. all three lenses support 4K 60fps HDR. recording; no compromises there. There. is also dual-lens recording up to 1080p. 30fps, and action recording up to 1080p. 240fps. However, it is a pity that the. V3 does not have cinematic LOG. recording features; but as everyone. knows, HONOR recently formed a. strategic partnership with IMAX, so. upcoming phones should feature more. professional capabilities, though they. haven't landed on the V3 yet. In the. settings, there are many useful options. , including various watermarks. The. choice of whether to let the camera. automatically switch lenses. And the. selection of lens focal length presets. Beyond recommendations like AI. photography, smart tracking, or. floating shutters, since you’ve. already bought a foldable phone, I. think what matters more to you is that. the Magic V2 also offers various. exclusive foldable features. For. example, when you place it on a table. in a semi-folded state, the camera. interface automatically splits into top. and bottom sections. It’s great for. taking group photos or time-lapses. You. can, of course, also use the large. screen to preview while shooting. You. can also use the external screen to. directly access the main lens,. ultra-wide angle, or even the telephoto. lens. Also, when taking pictures of. friends, remember to enable the. external screen sync preview so the. subject can see the frame. If you're. photographing children, we can choose. cute animations to grab their attention. . Alright, that's enough about the. features for now. Regarding the. performance everyone cares about, since. the Magic V2 has such good camera. hardware, I’ve gathered three popular. flagship foldables from this year:. Samsung’s Z Fold 5, Google’s Pixel. Fold, and the OPPO Find N3. Let’s. have a big showdown of these flagship. foldables. Here we go. In terms of. telephoto photography, a special. highlight of the Honor Magic flagship. series is that it includes Honor’s. signature AI super-resolution telephoto. algorithm; as long as what you're. shooting is content the AI can process,. it will enhance it. Look here, the AI. automatically triggers the special. super-resolution telephoto algorithm. I’ll show you a before-and-after. comparison for your reference. Note. that this feature requires an internet. connection, as it uses an online model. for real-time computation. I recommend. going into settings and turning on the. "Keep Original" option. That way, you. can view the before-and-after. comparison directly in your gallery and. choose the one you like best. Next,. let’s get into the telephoto. comparison. To be clear, our testing. standard remains fully automatic mode; if the AI decides not to intervene... Finally, for video, we’ve also. provided a 4K 60fps sample. Alright,. we’ve reached the end of the show; there really were a lot of samples! That’s all for this episode. Lastly,. producing this show isn't easy, so we. appreciate your support. Feel free to. join as a channel member or use the. YouTube Super Thanks button to help us. create more valuable review content. I’m Donkey, see you next time! If you. enjoyed this episode, don’t forget to.

subscribe to Boni and turn on the. notification bell to get our latest. review updates. Of course, you can also. find us on Facebook, Instagram, and. LINE@if...

item.content:encoded:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o9t4v-FZh3s

值得閱讀的理由

  • 一次掌握 Honor Magic V3 的輕薄設計、旗艦規格與相機配置。
  • 了解大摺疊手機在螢幕、電池、耐用性與日常使用上的實際體驗。
  • 整理作者對摺痕、配件及購機保固方案的觀察，方便評估是否適合入手。

摘要

旗艦規格塞進超薄摺疊機身

作者介紹 Honor Magic V3，指出它在維持旗艦硬體的同時，打造出極薄的摺疊機身。手機搭載高通 Snapdragon 8 Gen 3、16GB LPDDR5X 記憶體與 512GB 儲存空間，並配置 5150mAh 矽碳電池，支援 66W 有線及 50W 無線快充。相機方面則有 5000 萬畫素主鏡頭、超廣角微距鏡頭，以及支援 3.5 倍光學變焦的潛望式長焦鏡頭。

輕薄手感與購機保障

作者提到，Magic V3 的機身厚度約為 9.2 毫米，白色版本的數據則為 8.75 毫米，重量依版本約為 219 至 226 克，與 iPhone 16 Pro 系列相比也相當輕薄。展開後，手機提供近 8 吋的大螢幕，合起來仍可作為日常手機使用。作者也介紹上市優惠：在指定期限前購買，可獲一年延長保固與一年意外損壞保障；不過免費維修是否另收工資，仍有待確認。

外觀、摺痕與機身設計

白色版本採用航空級特殊纖維背蓋，搭配八角形相機模組與亮面轉軸。作者認為，近年大摺疊手機已大幅減輕、變薄，展開後的大螢幕也帶來一般手機難以取代的使用體驗。至於螢幕摺痕，作者表示 Magic V3 的表現符合現代摺疊機水準，略深於摺痕控制出色的 Galaxy Z Fold 6，但仍優於部分較早期機型；出廠預貼的抗反光保護膜，也能讓摺痕在展開時不那麼明顯。轉軸手感比前代紮實，並通過 SGS 50 萬次摺疊測試。

連接功能與盒裝配件

手機的電源鍵整合指紋辨識，底部 SIM 卡槽可放入兩張實體 SIM 卡，並支援 eSIM，方便旅行使用；機身頂部也配有紅外線發射器，可用來控制家電。盒裝內含充電器，以及附有支架與鏡頭保護設計的保護殼。作者認為，這些配件對日常使用相當實用。

內外螢幕與亮度實測

外螢幕為 6.43 吋 FHD+ OLED，內螢幕則為 7.92 吋 OLED，兩者皆支援 1 至 120Hz LTPO 更新率與最高 5000 尼特標示亮度；內螢幕採用超薄玻璃，兩面螢幕也都支援全螢幕 AOD。外螢幕另使用 Honor 的抗反光玻璃方案，作者指出它比一般亮面螢幕更不易反光，並具備較好的耐刮與抗摔能力。實測中，外螢幕峰值亮度達 5900 尼特，強光下全螢幕亮度為 2060 尼特；內螢幕峰值亮度則達 5340 尼特，全螢幕亮度為 1330 尼特，戶外使用有一定優勢。

螢幕色彩測試尚未完成

作者最後開始測試螢幕色彩準確度，並說明 Magic V3 提供標準、鮮豔與專業三種顯示模式。影片字幕在介紹各模式測試時中止，因此尚未呈現完整的色彩測量結果。

================================================

Friends, Taiwan has welcomed another. highly competitive flagship foldable. phone, the latest Magic V3 from Honor. The highlight of this device is that. Honor has managed to pack in top-tier. hardware while achieving the world's. thinnest foldable design. For instance,. the Magic V3 isn't just thin; Honor has. managed to cram in a high-density. 5150mAh large battery. Furthermore, it. utilizes a new generation of. silicon-carbon battery technology with. a 10%silicon content. The energy. density reaches 921Wh/L, which is. incredibly impressive by international. standards, and it supports 66W wired. and 50W wireless fast charging. Performance is also uncompromising,. featuring the Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Gen. 3 flagship processor, paired with the. increasingly rare 16GB of LPDDR5X RAM. and 512GB of storage. Crucially,. another major highlight of the Magic V3. is its well-rounded camera setup. This. includes a 50MP main lens, a 50MP. ultra-wide lens with macro capabilities. , and Honor has also included a 50MP. periscope telephoto lens with 3.5 x. optical zoom, featuring a large sensor. size. Compared to many in the foldable. camp still using 1/3 or 1/4 inch. sensors, this setup is truly luxurious. At the same time, the Magic V3 has. achieved IPX8 water resistance, making. it the foldable phone with the most. robust build quality currently. available in Taiwan. But the real point. is that even with all these flagship. specifications, the new Honor Magic V3. manages to be the world's thinnest at. just 9.2 mm. So, what kind of concept. is this? Simply put, I have Apple's. latest iPhone 16 Pro and 16 Pro Max in. my hands. When you place these two. alongside the Magic V3, that's right—. the V3 is effectively the same. thickness as the 16 Pro and even the 16. Pro Max, folks. The point is that my. white version weighs only 226 grams,. which is actually lighter than the 16. Pro Max. I have to say, large foldable. phones have really slimmed down in the. past two years. Overall, the first time. you get your hands on the Magic V3, the. feel is quite remarkable; I highly. recommend everyone go experience these. new-gen foldables in person.
